meta.source: 2026 FBS pool (denominator/fbs_pool_2026) under the books' FIT_SPEC bars; candidates from players.json fits benchmarks plus the P4 Down pool (headline grade at P4 rooms, projected benchmark at G6 rooms)
meta.snapshot: Pool is a Nov 17, 2026 in-season snapshot of PFF Ultimate exports.
meta.standards: Each team is measured against its conference median and its own level's median (G6 teams vs the G6 median, P4 teams vs the P4 median); both level medians are medians of team incumbents.
meta.depth_test_note: Recommended upgrades use the depth test under the path replacement doctrine (Tommy, Nov 19, 2026): the path works from the bottom of the room up toward its median, so a player counts when his benchmark beats the room's lowest-graded man — the bottom player is replaceable whatever his snap count, zero-volume men included — or when he slots into the room above a man with no grade on record (flagged depth_ungraded; a man with no grade on record is the first to fall off). Clearing the top man is flagged starter ("Beats your starter"). Below-bar rooms name no candidates on this page.
meta.ol_note: OL rooms carry named upgrade candidates under the same depth test as every other group (benchmark = headline OFF GRD + the OL translation delta, −4.4; incumbent bar 200 snaps) since the OL re-harvest brought the evaluated linemen into players.json (Nov 17, 2026).
meta.below_bar_note: A room with no volume-qualified incumbent is carried by its top player by volume, flagged below_bar with his volume and the bar printed; gaps are against the same medians (medians of qualified incumbents only). No upgrade candidates are computed for below-bar rooms. Team-comparison page only (Tommy, Nov 17, 2026) — the books' fits standard is unchanged.
